description_en: A past collaboration: Microvisioneer's manual whole-slide imaging, once offered under the X-WOW name, turned an ordinary microscope into a slide scanner. X-WOW no longer offers it; here is how it worked and who makes it now.
description_zh: 一段过去的合作：Microvisioneer 的手动全切片成像方案，曾以 X-WOW 的名义提供，能把普通显微镜变成切片扫描仪。X-WOW 现在已不再提供；这里讲它怎么工作，以及现在谁在做。
